_note: Curated resources for internship, entry (junior) and mid-level roles: Software Engineer, AI/ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Security Engineer, Computer Engineer, IT Support Specialist, Hardware Engineer, QA Engineer, Product Manager. Only these IDs may be cited. 'level' is who a resource suits best; 'roles' (optional) marks role-specific resources, which are preferred for those roles. 'credential' is what finishing it earns: 'certification' (an exam employers recognize), 'certificate' (a certificate of completion), or null (knowledge only). Costs and hours are approximate as of Oct 2026. All links were checked on 2026-10-23.
